look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: Find a large white, trumpet-shaped flower with a yellow throat; then inspect the broad, alternate, slightly rough-textured leaves and the persistent cup-shaped calyx around the developing fruit.
taxonomy_notes: Accepted Cordia boissieri A.DC. in POWO. This is not the similarly flowered narrow-leaved desert willow (Chilopsis linearis); do not use trumpet-shaped corollas alone.

project_inclusion.notes: County-level native-range certification deferred; no native-only metric inclusion.

morphology_keys.habit: Evergreen to semi-evergreen shrub or small spreading tree; rounded crown and stout branching twigs.
morphology_keys.leaves_attachment: Alternate, broadly ovate to elliptic, thick leaves; surfaces may feel rough or sandpapery; check petiole and leaf margins.
morphology_keys.flower_reproductive: Large showy white funnel-shaped flowers with yellow center; inspect five spreading corolla lobes and calyx.
morphology_keys.fruit_seed: Fleshy pale fruit enclosed partly by the persistent calyx; confirm fruit shape with a later close-up.
morphology_keys.stem_bud: Woody twigs; inspect alternate leaf scars and young growth.

confused_with: Chilopsis linearis (desert willow; very narrow leaves, different family)
Other planted Cordia species (compare leaf and fruit details)
comparisons.key_distinctions: Broad rough leaves plus white funnel flowers and persistent calyx; do not identify from flowers alone.
